profile.headline: Lead Data Engineer @ Northern Trust | Scaling Enterprise Data Platforms & Mentoring High-Performing Teams | Cloud, Big Data, GenAI Pipelines
profile.summary:
I am a Data Engineering Executive with nearly two decades of experience building, scaling, and modernizing high-throughput data infrastructure for the world's leading financial institutions and enterprises. I specialize in bridging the gap between complex data architectures and strategic business outcomes—transforming legacy data warehouses into agile, cloud-native, and AI-ready platforms.

Throughout my career, I have led cross-functional organizations to design terabyte-scale streaming and batch processing systems, optimize multi-million dollar cloud budgets, and establish robust data governance frameworks. I thrive at the intersection of technical excellence and people leadership—building high-performing engineering cultures, mentoring technical leaders, and aligning stakeholders across product, business, and data science teams.

Core Expertise:
- Enterprise Data Strategy & Modernization (Cloud, Mesh, Fabric)
- Scalable Distributed Systems (Enterprise Data Lake, Cloud Data Warehouses, Streaming)
- Executive Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Alignment
- Engineering Org Leadership & Talent Development (Global/Hybrid Teams)

positions.title: Data Integration Specialist
positions.description:
• Design and develop DataStage parallel jobs using transformer, join, lookup, sequential file stage, oracle connectors. 
• Work with business analyst to develop analytic solution that meets business requirement.
• Use swagger API and parse JSON objects to derive data from RESTful web services. Prepare wrapper script in python/UNIX to execute job. 
• Prepare user documentation for application and maintain source library.
TOOLS: IBM Infosphere DataStage 8.5, Linux, Oracle, Control M, JIRA, Python.

positions.title: Data Analytic Engineer - Ab Initio Consultant
positions.description:
• Profile, Analyze and evaluate Auto & Property policy data and prepare data plate form using Ab Initio for actuary. Leverage enterprise data warehouse and different tools to develop corporate research data files, information platforms or data spaces.
• Evaluate technical designs and data mapping documents, utilize design to develop accurate defect free code, test programs using Ab-Initio, SQL, Shell Scripting, Java, python, oracle, SAS on UNIX environment. 
• Execute, monitor and validate data of key policy, quotes and claim application, provide on-site support and perform root-cause analysis & fix any issues that arise in data sets. 
• Participate in Production Support transition meetings. Participate in code reviews, and test plan reviews. Provides input in creating detailed ETL development estimates or change requests.
• Perform performance tuning on both UNIX ETL and Oracle database environments
• Work closely with Data scientist, Actuary and business managers to prepare requested data sets. Prepare use case document to evaluate different best suitable ETL tools.
positions.insights: Skills: PL/SQL · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · GNU/Linux · Data Migration · SQL · Shell Scripting · Oracle · Agile Software Development · Computer Science · Linux · Data Integration · Databases · Ab Initio · Unix · Performance Tuning

positions.title: Lead ETL developer - Ab Initio
positions.description:
• Provided subject matter expertise in the analysis and preparation of specifications and plans for development/modification of the EDW.
• Designed PULSE data marts and support business analytic using the Teradata database. Pro-actively identify and communicated scope, design, development issues and recommend potential solutions.
• Developed ETL code to meet all technical specifications and business requirements according to the established designs, assisted & mentor other team members. 
• Coordinated work with offshore team members, business analyst and data analyst to resolve gaps in EDW design specifications.
• Coordinated with data modeler/DBA to design data model & integrate DB changes. 
• Created, scheduled new jobs and Supported existing production job runs 
• Keep ETL artifacts in EME and deploy it to production using Live_Queue process.
positions.insights: Skills: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Autosys · GNU/Linux · Data Migration · SQL · Shell Scripting · Agile Software Development · Computer Science · Linux · Data Integration · Teradata · Databases · XML · Ab Initio · Unix

positions.title: Data Integration Consultant (Ab Initio)
positions.description:
• Migrate PERL drivers implemented using MSS framework into Conduct>IT plan
• Analyzed and redesign, changed long running process to improve performance.
• Support data warehous table load activities, analyze and resolve if any queries arise from stackholders.
positions.insights: Skills: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · GNU/Linux · SQL · Shell Scripting · Oracle · Computer Science · Linux · Data Integration · Support Engineers · Databases · Ab Initio · Unix

positions.title: Tech Lead - Ab Initio/Java Specialist
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
• Articulate technical considerations with the business user, data architect and QA team members to implement ETL process using Ab Initio products
• Gather requirements and prepare technical specifications, design and document ETL flow. 
• Implement Ab Initio graphs using GDE 3.0.4 with rich A>I Components 
• Implement various partitioning techniques (like data, Component and Pipeline), re-partitioning technique and multi-partition file and flow to speed up the processing of data wherever applicable.
• Setup sandboxes in physical environment and create EME projects in Dev and QA environments,
• Maintain issue log, prioritize, resolve critical one and coordinate remaining issues with offshore team member, resolve doubts related to requirements / design and guide them on technical issues.
• Review A>I graphs and shell script implemented by team members for quality check. 
• Mentor team to optimize A>I Graphs to utilizes less memory and improve process performance.
• Handle and resolve live production issues raised by user within given SLA.
• Prepare test case and test Ab Initio graphs and UNIX script in development and QA environment for various test scenario. Acquiring sign off from SIT and UAT team for each Production release.
• Providing weekly status of project activities to management 
• Create and deploy Ab Initio tag on QA environment and support production release activities.
• Analyze claims data that involves verification of data entered in system every financial month and determine if the claims and drafts submitted by the insured is in accordance with policy rules defined by underwriter.
• Debug and analyze stored procedure written in PL-SQL for business queries.
positions.insights: Skills: PL/SQL · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · GNU/Linux · SQL · Shell Scripting · Java · Oracle · Computer Science · Linux · Data Integration · Support Engineers · Databases · Ab Initio · Unix

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
• Providing 3rd level support to business process flow in the production environment
• Monitoring production jobs, resolving issues occurred in daily operation and inform business. 
• Document, develop, test and deploy changes in web application and business process flow
• Consult with business user and various data team to investigate issue and prepare technical specification document based on analysis
• Enhance functionality of existing java based web application, prepare and review test cases
• Analyze data, write complex SQL query to prepare adhoc report requested by business user
positions.insights: Skills: PL/SQL · SQL · Java · Oracle · Computer Science · Databases · Unix
